title: Scalable Pontryagin-Guided Adjoint-to-Control Recovery for Constrained Dynamic Portfolio Choice
summary: We study continuous-time multi-asset portfolio choice and consumption under smooth pointwise constraints, including state-dependent feasible sets. The method separates dynamic information acquisition from local constrained recovery. A pointwise-feasible neural actor generates reference rollouts; after training, its realized latent outputs are frozen and first- and second-order adjoints are harvested from a fixed-latent open-loop backpropagation-through-time graph.
